Role : Software Engineer 
 Location : Omaha NE 
 Duration : Fulltime 
 
 Job description: 
 
 Software Development using C/C++ 
 Strong academic background and good understanding of data structures and algorithms. 
 Very good knowledge of C, Shell scripting, Makefiles 
 Good knowledge on Misra C guidelines for C programming 
 Knowledge on messaging middleware and publish subscribe communication pattern 
 Knowledge about continuous integration tools (Jenkins) 
 Added advantage if worked in automotive embedded project development using C. 
 Strong knowledge on networking concepts (TCP/IP module). 
 Good understanding of Linux concepts like IPC mechanisms, system calls, commands etc. 
 Good knowledge on tools like GDB, Valgrind, Performance verification. 
 Prior Experience in using SVN/Bug tracking tools 
 Self-motivated with the ability to work with minimal supervision 
 Ability to work well in a team 
 Ability to work well in a dynamic environment and can respond positively to change 
 Good verbal and written communication skills 
 
 
 Thanks & Regards 
 Selva


 embedded, Misra C


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
